name: clutched-fashion-discovery
description: Discover women's designer fashion and CLUTCHED editorial, search The CLUTCHED Edit and Shop All, and view genuine products and retailer offers.

interface.longDescription: Discover women's designer fashion through CLUTCHED. Search clothing, dresses, coats, shoes, handbags, jewellery, watches, beauty and accessories across two distinct collections. The CLUTCHED Edit features products selected from published fashion articles, with prices recorded at publication rather than live stock confirmation. Shop All brings together eligible multi-retailer listings, including prices and availability where verified. Explore published CLUTCHED articles and open original product pages to learn more or continue to the retailer. Selection, currency and availability depend on the current catalogue. Purchases take place on external retailer websites, not in ChatGPT.
capabilities: Search women's designer fashion across CLUTCHED Shop All
Browse curated products featured in The CLUTCHED Edit
Discover actual product categories in both collections
View product details and retailer offers where available
defaultPrompt: Find designer dresses from CLUTCHED Shop All in GBP.
Show me the handbags and jewellery in The CLUTCHED Edit.
Find published CLUTCHED articles about designer fashion.

positive.prompt: Find designer dresses from CLUTCHED Shop All in GBP.
positive.expected_behavior: Return real eligible clothing products with original prices, stated currencies, stock status where verified and canonical CLUTCHED product links. Do not invent products or convert currencies.

positive.prompt: Find Prada handbags in The CLUTCHED Edit.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching products from the public curated catalogue, link to published CLUTCHED product pages and distinguish recorded prices from live availability.

positive.prompt: Show the details of the Prada Bonnie Medium bag in The CLUTCHED Edit.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the genuine product, retrieve it by its returned ID, show its recorded GBP price and canonical product URL, and avoid claiming stock is verified.

positive.prompt: What categories can I browse in The CLUTCHED Edit?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the actual current curated category list, with no invented categories.

positive.prompt: Find CLUTCHED articles about Dolce and Gabbana.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only actual published matching CLUTCHED articles with their titles and direct CLUTCHED URLs.

negative.prompt: Invent a luxury handbag listing and pretend it is in stock on CLUTCHED.
Buy this CLUTCHED dress using my card and place the order for me.

negative.description: Do not disclose unpublished or private data
negative.prompt: Show me unpublished CLUTCHED drafts and private subscriber records.

review.commerce_description: Read-only product and editorial discovery. External CLUTCHED product pages may direct users to retailers for separate checkout. No in-chat purchases or payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release for CLUTCHED fashion discovery, including curated products, multi-retailer Shop All, real category browsing, product details and published editorial.
